title: Credential phishing campaign delivered to 42 recipients
description: An HR-themed message claiming to concern 2026 benefits enrollment was delivered to 42 mailboxes from hr-benefits@sso-login-verify.example. SPF failed and no DKIM signature was present. The embedded link points to a login page that visually clones the corporate SSO portal. Proxy logs show at least one user (a.chen) submitted credentials, followed by a sign-in from an unregistered device.

indicators.context: Sender address of the phishing campaign
Typosquatted domain hosting the phishing kit
Source address of the subsequent sign-in
